issue.title: Establish local dev environments
issue.body:
Getting started with mobile development needs some preparation work for your local machine to have all of the proper tooling. To setup your local dev environment you might try the following:
- Follow Android '[Get Started](https://developer.android.com/get-started/overview)' tutorial
- Install emulator for iOS if on MacOS - [checkout xcode simulator docs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/running-your-app-in-simulator-or-on-a-device)
- Lookup emulator integration for your IDE

Dev time - ET: 4hrs
